assumptions: A fictional, West Coast-based integrated agency. All three offices use Pacific Time.
Stable employee, team, project and skill IDs are retained. Names and business labels are new English-language synthetic data.
USD fees and loaded labor costs are synthetic assumptions, not market salary estimates or currency conversions.
Local wall times are rebased for the US simulation. IANA timezone rules handle the November 1 daylight-saving transition.
Candidate windows are deliberate demo coverage fixtures, not a representative workforce sample.
The integrated campaign benchmark compresses a normal multiweek engagement into ten business days; use the narrative workflow for realistic elapsed planning times.

migration.currency_fields: All _cny fields replaced by _usd; values reparameterized.
migration.date_policy: Local dates retained, timestamps rebuilt with America/Los_Angeles; do not parse PT as a fixed UTC offset.
